provenance.description: An open-source sixteen-joint biped presented as source-linked mechanical assemblies.
provenance.note: Derived display geometry is simplified from pinned source STL files. Finishes, exploded offsets and pose animation are illustrative; not manufacturing data, learned walking or a physically balanced simulation.
